basic_info.description: Welcome to 522 Clipper Street - a charming Noe Valley gem! Lovingly owned by the same owner for over 20 years, this charming residence offers a rare blend of original character and thoughtful updates in the heart of Noe Valley. The main level features three spacious bedrooms and two remodeled bathrooms, highlighted by gorgeous hardwood floors and elegant period details throughout. A recently updated kitchen completes the inviting, light-filled living space.  On the lower level, with separate outdoor access, you'll find a bonus bedroom or flexible living space along with a full bathroom ideal for guests, or a home office. This versatile area opens directly to the backyard and offers exciting potential for added functionality. Located just two blocks from the vibrant 24th Street corridor, with unbeatable weather and easy commuter access, this is an incredible opportunity to own a timeless home in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods.
